title: Feedback Queue — Bugs / UX / Resources

commits.message: fix(portfolio): show courses for secondary-enrolled learners in evidence subject dropdown
commits.acceptance: Selecting a child enrolled primary OR secondary shows the course in the Subject dropdown and evidence can be saved.
commits.verifyFirst: Read-only: confirm whether missing courses for household_1781012946471 are secondary-enrollment or different-school-year before finalizing.

commits.message: fix(resources): honor household school days when distributing generated lessons
tests: features/resources/__tests__: computeDueDates skips non-school weekdays for all cadences
commits.acceptance: No generated dueDate falls on a weekday outside household.schoolDays for any pacing option.

commits.message: fix(resources): keep Save-to-plan visible with a hint before lessons are generated
commits.acceptance: Save-to-plan is visible before generation (disabled with hint).

commits.message: fix(learning-time): clarify scheduled Start/End time applies to this session only
commits.acceptance: Scheduled Start/End inputs state they apply to this one session, not a recurring schedule.

commits.message: fix(dashboard): label Records Readiness tiles as current-week scope
tests: features/dashboard/__tests__/integration: Records Readiness subtitle references current week
commits.acceptance: Records Readiness states its tiles cover the current week. No new seed/store data.

commits.message: feat(resources): let generation start from a chosen chapter/page
tests: service unit: startAt=5 -> first title unit 5, correct count
commits.acceptance: Choosing start = N generates lessons beginning at unit N.

commits.message: feat(resources): choose which weekdays a generated course is taught
tests: integration: deselecting Wednesday yields no Wednesday due dates
commits.acceptance: Selecting M/W/F schedules lessons only on those weekdays.

commits.message: feat(resources): link a resource to enrolled courses from the resource form
tests: API: linking resource->course creates subjectResources row; course.resourceIds includes it
integration: ResourceForm course multiselect saves link
commits.acceptance: Adding/editing a resource can attach it to enrolled course(s); link shows on both sides.
commits.architectureNote: subjectResources ownership stays with subjects; resources UI calls subjects API/service, never the subjects repo directly.

commits.message: feat(resources): add enrolled-course dropdown to the resource form
tests: integration: dropdown lists enrolled courses; selecting one links the resource
commits.acceptance: User can pick an enrolled class from a dropdown to link the resource, instead of only free-text category.

outOfScope: any DB migration (GenerateLessonsInput additions are type-only)
